notes.title: Update! v.0.2.1
notes.notes:
Redesigned lighting
 Fixed a bug with "darkness"
 Fixed a bug with a dump of objects
 The behavior of the fish has been temporarily changed. The fish is no longer twitching
 Removed the New Year's hat for the pike

notes.title: Update! v.0.2.0
notes.notes: Each skoof has an apartment!  Now, before going fishing, skuf needs to complete all the instructions from his wife and preferably not destroy the entire apartment in the process! Or is it not necessary?... New interactive environment and improved interaction with objects! Try the new version right now!

notes.title: Update! v.0.1.3
notes.notes:
A small update:

 The test location is hidden
 Fixed a table collision. The table can no longer stand on the water
 Slightly increased the probability of catching fish

notes.title: Update! v.0.1.2
notes.notes:
A small update with the correction of a couple of bugs:

 Fixed duplicating items with fish
 Fixed a bug that allows you to catch beer out of the water

notes.title: The new version is available again!
notes.notes: Version 0.1.1 is available for installation again! Bugs have been fixed, cigarettes are available again. Reflections on the water have also been fixed

notes.title: Update delay
notes.notes: You have found something that the developer himself could not find! In short, the update has been postponed to fix critical bugs. Version 0.1.1 will be available again soon

notes.title: Update! v.0.1.1
notes.notes:
Optimization work has been carried out
 Improved graphics
 Fixed a bug where not all available screen resolutions were displayed in the settings
 The object in your hands no longer rotates by inertia
 Fixed character colliders
 The scope size has been changed
 Now the sight changes its color
 Cigarettes have been temporarily removed
 Fixed animation of hands when jumping
